value.title: claude-inbound-accept-global
value.summary: pij enforces crossSessionInbound=accept in every Claude home on every machine it runs on, so a hand-started Claude receives peer messages as real turns with no operator settings edit.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: RULING 2026-09-02 (government rulings/2026-09-02-claude-inbound-accept-is-global.md, Jordan: 'the global accept fix is fine, get it in, get it working, make sure it gets set on other machines too'). Evidence: with `"crossSessionInbound":"accept"` in ~/.claude/settings.json a RUNNING Claude session (vicuna, up since Aug 28) went from held/refused to delivered/injected-to-transport (spine 2077) — Claude re-reads settings live, no restart. Without it the Claude client holds or refuses every pij frame (client-side gate; pij's own sender gate is already open after s121/af139cb4). Today it was hand-applied on one machine; this plan makes pij apply it itself, idempotently, everywhere. The from-mode=bypass wire marker stays withheld (uds.rs:925 pin stands).

sections.name: goals
value: G1 ensure_claude_inbound_accept(): for each Claude home (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if set, else $HOME/.claude; plus $HOME/.claude-alt when it exists) read settings.json; if the key is absent or not `accept`, write a timestamped backup then rewrite with ONLY that key added/changed (preserve every other key and ordering as far as serde_json allows); malformed JSON → refuse to touch it and report; missing file → create it with just that key.

G2 Call sites: rs daemon boot (run_daemon in crates/cli/src/main.rs, before listening) and every Claude registration (adopt / spawn / phonehome path through crates/daemon/src/registration.rs register()). Idempotent, cheap (one stat + read when already accept).

G3 Visibility: one startup log line naming homes touched/skipped; a spine event `config.claude-inbound-ensured` with {home, before, after} on every CHANGE (not on no-op); `pij-rs doctor claude-inbound` prints the current state per home without writing.
G4 Never emit from-mode on the wire; this plan changes no transport frame.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No change to crates/transport/src/uds.rs frames or the uds.rs:925 pin.

value.text: Unit (pure fn over a temp dir): absent file → created with the key; key absent → added, other keys byte-preserved, backup written; key=hold → changed, backup written; already accept → no write, no backup, no event; malformed JSON → untouched, reported. RED-first on the pre-fix tree.
value.receipt: cargo test -p pij-harnesses claude_settings: 10 passed; r3 review APPROVE

value.text: Integration: daemon boot with a temp HOME lacking the key → key present after boot, spine has config.claude-inbound-ensured; second boot → no new event.
value.receipt: cargo test -p pij-cli --test claude_inbound: two boots, one config event; 2 passed

value.text: LIVE (done-bar ruling): on this machine, remove the key from ~/.claude/settings.json (backup first), restart an ISOLATED rs daemon built from the branch with HOME pointed appropriately or the real home per PM judgement, confirm the key is back, then hand-start `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` WITHOUT any --settings flag in a tmux window, type /pij ready, send it a message from another seat → real type=user turn in its transcript, outcome delivered/injected-to-transport, no pointer. Pane transcript + spine rows pasted into assets/live-claude-no-settings.md.
